csv_project_name: Engineering Service for DeQuincy Industrial Airpark
csv_scope_of_work: City of DeQuincy is requesting submittal of qualification statements, on State of Louisiana Form SF 330, from firms interested in providing engineering, design, planning, geotechnical, environmental and other related aspects of service involved in the evaluation, development, design, construction management, and grant administration services for projects included in the Capital Improvement Program for the DeQuincy Industrial Airpark, DeQuincy, Louisiana for the project period of approximately 3-5 years. All work shall be performed in accordance with Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) and Louisiana DOTDAviation requirements, procedures, and policies. Project implementation may be contingent upon FAA and Louisiana DOTD -Aviation approval and funding, with emphasis on AIP eligible projects.
